<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915585_theRebbe_828" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915585_theRebbe_828__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Creation comes from both speech and will: the substance of each thing is from speech, while its form is from will, drawn through wisdom.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">The explanation is,</t>
    <t s="1">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="2">"Whatever Hashem desires, He does"</t>
    <t s="3">(that creation is from the aspect of desire and will),</t>
    <t s="4">and it is written,</t>
    <t s="5">"By the word of Hashem the heavens were made"</t>
    <t s="6">(that creation is from the aspect of speech),</t>
    <t s="7">and the explanation of this is,</t>
    <t s="8">that the creation of the substance of every thing is from the aspect of speech.</t>
    <t s="9">And this is what our sages, of blessed memory, said,</t>
    <t s="10">"With ten utterances the world was created,"</t>
    <t s="11">that in the utterance "Let there be light," light was brought into being, and in the utterance "Let there be a firmament," the firmament was brought into being,</t>
    <t s="12">and so it is with all created beings.</t>
    <t s="13">And the creation of the form in every thing is from the aspect of will.</t>
    <t s="14">For the form of created beings was not specified in the ten utterances,</t>
    <t s="15">and that every created being has a form</t>
    <t s="16">[both its physical picture,</t>
    <t s="17">and its nature and characteristics]</t>
    <t s="18">is from the aspect of will.</t>
    <t s="19">And what is written,</t>
    <t s="20">"All of them You made with wisdom,"</t>
    <t s="21">is,</t>
    <t s="22">that the drawing down of the will is through wisdom.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Creation from both will and speech allows the world to be a tangible entity that can be transformed into a dwelling for the blessed One through service.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the reason for this, that creation is from two matters,</t>
    <t s="1">from the aspect of speech and from the aspect of will,</t>
    <t s="2">is,</t>
    <t s="3">that the ultimate intention in the creation of the world is that the world</t>
    <t s="4">(in and of itself)</t>
    <t s="5">be a tangible entity, and through the service of man</t>
    <t s="6">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="7">bittul (self-nullification) be drawn into it,</t>
    <t s="8">even to such a degree of bittul that the world becomes a dwelling place for the blessed One.</t>
    <t s="9">And the two aspects in the world — that in and of itself it is a tangible entity,</t>
    <t s="10">and that nevertheless it is possible to draw bittul into it</t>
    <t s="11">— are through its creation being from the aspect of will and from the aspect of speech.</t>
    <t s="12">For if all creation</t>
    <t s="13">(even the creation of the substance of created beings)</t>
    <t s="14">were from the aspect of will, the world would be nullified in existence,</t>
    <t s="15">and in order for the world to exist as a tangible entity, it is through being created by the word of Hashem.</t>
    <t s="16">And if all creation</t>
    <t s="17">(even the creation of the form of created beings)</t>
    <t s="18">were from the aspect of speech,</t>
    <t s="19">the world would not be connected to the matter of bittul.</t>
    <t s="20">And through the creation of the form of created beings being from the aspect of will,</t>
    <t s="21">as it is drawn into the aspect of speech</t>
    <t s="22">[for that the form of created beings is the picture of the substance is because the will is drawn into the speech],</t>
    <t s="23">through this it is possible to draw</t>
    <t s="24">(through service)</t>
    <t s="25">that even the tangible entity that came into being from speech be in a state of bittul.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Will is not a tangible existence but a revelation of essence, so its creations are for the completion of the will, while speech is a separate garment that produces tangible existence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="2">that the reason for this, that the bittul of created beings is drawn from the aspect of will and the tangibility of created beings from the aspect of speech,</t>
    <t s="3">is,</t>
    <t s="4">that will is not an existence, but is only a revelation of the essence</t>
    <t s="5">(similar to will in the human soul,</t>
    <t s="6">which is only an inclination and drawing of the soul),</t>
    <t s="7">and therefore also the creation from will,</t>
    <t s="8">its matter is</t>
    <t s="9">(not that created beings come into existence,</t>
    <t s="10">but rather)</t>
    <t s="11">that through the creation the will is completed.</t>
    <t s="12">And speech is a separate garment.</t>
    <t s="13">For in addition to speech being an existence,</t>
    <t s="14">since its matter is that one speaks to another,</t>
    <t s="15">behold, in this itself it is separate from the speaking person,</t>
    <t s="16">to the extent that speech actually goes out and separates from the person.</t>
    <t s="17">And therefore</t>
    <t s="18">the creation from speech is a tangible existence.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
